# CUHK — Multi-function Chinese Character Database

The Chinese University of Hong Kong's online dictionary is the selected specialist carrier. Accessed 8 September 2026; no print-edition identity is inferred. The complete 鄉 形義通解 commentary was read from the saved HTML. Referenced inscriptions and scholarship are dictionary-reported witnesses, not separately collated here.

<a id="passages"></a>
<a id="cuhk-multifunction-chinese-character-database-q001"></a>
## 鄉 — facing, shared eating, orientation and village

**Paraphrase:** The entry reads early figures facing a food vessel and distinguishes banquet/ritual, orientation and later settlement uses. Its village account includes competing graphic/phonetic and communal-meal explanations; these are not merged into a single origin claim.

**Locator:** s.v. 鄉, 形義通解, 略說 and complete 詳解.

**Access:** [CUHK entry](https://humanum.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/Lexis/lexi-mf/search.php?word=%E9%84%89).

**Verification:** selected commentary read 2026-09-08; paraphrase-ready. Separate 嚮/饗/響 entries, historical phonology and inscriptions remain separate tasks. The dictionary does not establish Taylor's philosophical account of community.

The selected passages **source** [E1's historical branches](../../../../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md), which **return-to** [the whole-field](../../../../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md). Source evidence and Taylor's authorial operation keep distinct standing.
